realizes.rationale: Diverts archived/placeholder explainer targets into the first-request form before ordinary posting; only the no-live-target branch bypasses settlement of the whole collection.
Captures picks/text once and sends one full body to each chosen target independently.
This parser is where a delivery's fields arrive from the server, so the reset has to survive here.
Hands every target's answer to `settle` with the pick ids and text that Send carried.

1.note: messageRepository supplies optional repository context from the shown page, the first structured reference or the recipient’s task (omitted when absent); it does not post or decide whether an archived explainer target is diverted.

2.note: parseDelivery accepts named delivered, held or refused answers and retains message-file identity, reason, detail and a supplied provider-limit reset without treating other answers as a delivery.

3.note: serverDetail reads a textual server detail or joins validation error locations and messages so a refused ordinary send retains the host’s stated reason.

4.note: Before a native send, sendTray separates archived/placeholder explainer targets from live recipients. The first archived target opens its leaf's first-request form with the current text; when no live target remains it returns without wiring picks or posting, preserving the collection. In a mixed selection, the remaining live targets still post and their ordinary settlement applies; this module does not report the first-request handoff as a delivered message. Mixed selections follow ordinary live-target settlement, which can consume the shared picks for successful live recipients.
